reasoning: On the season so far the Pistons are the stronger team; with home court the Pistons start about 9 points better, in a game of about 218 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Magic.
The mental side leans about 0 points towards the Pistons (look-ahead).
Bottom line: the Pistons win 73 times in 100, by about 8; most games like this end between 191 and 239 total points.
